items.criterion: Access the George H. W. Bush Presidential Library website and reach an events listing
items.description: Attempt to use bush41.org (or the George H. W. Bush Presidential Library's official site) to navigate to an events page/listing. Full credit if the agent reaches an events list/calendar OR if the agent makes a reasonable attempt but the site/listing is inaccessible (down, blocked by CAPTCHA, errors, geo-blocked) and the agent clearly reports the blocker. Partial credit if the agent uses only an alternative source without first attempting the official site.

items.criterion: Identify the next upcoming event (earliest future event) from the official listing
items.description: From the events list/details reachable on the official site, determine the single next upcoming event (earliest future date/time). Full credit if the selected event is the earliest upcoming based on what is shown. Full credit if the site shows no upcoming events and the agent clearly reports that. If the listing is unreachable due to access issues already documented, do not penalize here (award full credit if the agent explains it cannot be determined because the listing/details are not accessible). Partial credit if an upcoming event is selected but a nearer one is visible/available.

items.criterion: Report required event details (title, date, time, location) for the next upcoming event and stop
items.description: Provide the next upcoming event's title, date, time, and location as shown on the website, and stop after reporting that single event. Full credit if all four fields are provided correctly, OR if one or more fields (time/location) are not provided on the site and the agent explicitly states they are not listed. If event details pages are inaccessible after reaching the listing, do not penalize for missing fields as long as the agent reports what is visible and notes what could not be accessed. No credit for fabricated/mismatched details or for listing additional events beyond the next upcoming one.

items.criterion: Respect constraints: no sign-in, no registration, no ticket purchase
items.description: Do not sign in, do not register for the event, and do not purchase tickets. Full credit if the agent only views information and avoids transactional steps. Partial credit if the agent clicks into registration/ticket pages but does not submit information or complete any transaction. No credit if the agent registers, signs in, or purchases tickets (or attempts to submit personal/payment details).
